head_commit.message:
docs(ci): improve benchmark transparency, repository organization and native verification

- Establish canonical benchmark dataset in benchmarks/canonical_benchmarks_v0.1.0.json with full provenance metadata and deterministic report generator.
- Add consistency check (generate_benchmark_reports.py --check) to CI.
- Reconcile benchmark discrepancies across Quant Backtest, AR Spatial, Geo Distance, PDF Cleaner, PII Scrubber, OCR Matcher, and RAG Chunker.
- Rewrite README to honestly document supported typed subset, limitations, and 'Why Mojo Hotloop?' architectural comparison with Numba and Codon.
- Move historical phase reports and internal validation records to docs/history/ with indexing README clarifying internal engineering status.
- Add dedicated GitHub Actions native-verification job (ubuntu-24.04, Python 3.12, Mojo 1.2.0) testing real compilation and execution of all 7 use cases.
- Add dual CI status badges distinguishing Python-only and real native verification.
- Reconcile Modular trademark attribution and independent project disclaimers.

Signed-off-by: gaurav <gaurav@workstation-10.localdomain>
